tools.name: syft
tools.why: package is the only category with no fallback: syft is the sole source of the package inventory and the dependency-of edges, across ~30 ecosystems

tools.name: uv
tools.why: the five file-scanning skills run the bundled depscan.py via `uv run --script`; each skill documents a python3 fallback, and depscan.py declares no dependencies so the fallback works

tools.name: git
tools.why: depscan.py prefers `git ls-files` so .gitignore is honoured; it falls back to a filesystem walk when git is unavailable or the target is not a repo

tools.name: mmdc
tools.why: the report skill verifies its generated Mermaid renders when it is available
